يرتهنوا (form VIII)
# يَرْتَهِنُوا (yartahinū) /jar.ta.hi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# يُرْتَهَنُوا (yurtahanū) /jur.ta.ha.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
